caption: The drawing depicts a square pattern bordered by a solid green line. Inside the border, there is a light beige background filled with diagonal parallel lines. Within the border, evenly spaced around the four sides, are stylized floral motifs composed of green leaves and red-pink flower shapes. The interior of the large square is divided into a grid of smaller squares, with each square featuring floral designs in green and red-pink hues. At the center of the composition is a larger floral motif consisting of five red-pink petal shapes centered around a circular cluster of small green circles. Surrounding the central motif are four symmetrical floral designs, each comprising a red-pink oval flanked by green leaves that radiate outward. The overall arrangement forms a balanced, geometric composition utilizing the colors green, red-pink, and beige, with clear repetition and symmetry in the floral patterns.
title: Applique Quilt
